summary: Embercloud for Startups grants $100 in free API credits after application approval. Credits cover EmberCloud models including GLM-5 and GLM-4.7 via an OpenAI-compatible API. No credit card is required to apply. After approval, add $5 to verify the company and start building.
claim_steps: Apply at embercloud.ai/startups (no credit card required).
Wait for review (the page says a few business days).
After approval, add $5 to verify your company.
Use the OpenAI-compatible API with GLM-5, GLM-4.7, and other EmberCloud models.

social_proof.title: Embercloud for Startups | $100 in Free API Credits
